mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, title, rank_num, hot_value, tags, is_ranked, is_special, source_url, crawl_time, created_at FROM hotspot ORDER BY crawl_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT hs.hotspot_id AS id, hs.platform, hs.title, hs.rank_num, hs.hot_value, hs.tags, hs.is_ranked, hs.is_special, h.source_url, hs.crawl_time, hs.created_at FROM hotspot_snapshot hs LEFT JOIN hotspot h ON hs.hotspot_id = h.id WHERE hs.platform = #{platform} AND hs.crawl_time = ( SELECT MAX(crawl_time) FROM hotspot_snapshot WHERE platform = #{platform} ) ORDER BY hs.is_special DESC, CASE WHEN hs.rank_num IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, hs.rank_num ASC, hs.hot_value DESC, hs.id DESC

SELECT h.id, h.platform, h.title, h.rank_num, h.hot_value, h.tags, h.is_ranked, h.is_special, h.source_url, h.crawl_time, h.created_at, s.summary AS aiSummary, s.analysis_type AS analysisType, s.related_hotspot_ids AS relatedHotspotIds, s.related_platforms AS relatedPlatforms FROM hotspot h LEFT JOIN hotspot_ai_summary s ON h.id = s.hotspot_id WHERE h.id = #{id}

SELECT id, platform, title, rank_num, hot_value, tags, is_ranked, is_special, source_url, crawl_time, created_at FROM hotspot WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY crawl_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT h.platform AS platform, COUNT(DISTINCT ht.hotspot_id) AS count FROM hotspot_trend ht JOIN hotspot h ON ht.hotspot_id = h.id WHERE DATE(ht.record_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY h.platform ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT h.id, h.platform, h.title, t.max_hot_value AS maxHotValue, h.source_url AS sourceUrl FROM hotspot h JOIN ( SELECT ht.hotspot_id, MAX(ht.hot_value) AS max_hot_value FROM hotspot_trend ht JOIN hotspot h2 ON ht.hotspot_id = h2.id WHERE h2.platform = #{platform} AND DATE(ht.record_time) = CURDATE() GROUP BY ht.hotspot_id ) t ON h.id = t.hotspot_id WHERE h.platform = #{platform} ORDER BY t.max_hot_value DESC, h.id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ds.hotspot_id AS hotspotId, ds.platform AS platform, ds.title AS title, ds.max_hot_value AS maxHotValue, ds.best_rank_num AS bestRankNum, ds.appear_count AS appearCount, ds.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, ds.is_special AS isSpecial, h.source_url AS sourceUrl FROM hotspot_daily_summary ds LEFT JOIN hotspot h ON ds.hotspot_id = h.id WHERE ds.platform = #{platform} AND ds.summary_date = #{date} ORDER BY ds.is_special ASC, ds.max_hot_value DESC, CASE WHEN ds.best_rank_num IS NULL THEN 999999 ELSE ds.best_rank_num END ASC, ds.hotspot_id DESC
